_: The tests that are about this repository only: its own workflows and commit identity, its own SEO copy lengths and the white-label tools, which a build does not get. A white-label build leaves these files out (tools/whitelabel/build.mjs excluded()); every other test runs in every build, adapted through tests/brand-facts.js. A path ending in * is a prefix.

files.why: this repository's commit identity and its hooks
this repository's workflows (preview, speed, IndexNow, WebGPU); a build gets only its rules.yml
the page speed workflow, which a build does not get
the nightly WebGPU workflow, which a build does not get
the IndexNow workflow and this site's own URLs
this site's SEO copy lengths; a build's renamed copy is longer or shorter
the language folders are git-ignored here and written on publish; a build commits them (its mirror is the published site)
the mascot slot with the sample overlay (brand/profiles/overlays), which a build does not ship; a build's own mascot runs tests/buddy/overlay.test.html
the mascot slot's size and roaming with the sample overlay (brand/profiles/overlays), which a build does not ship; a build's own mascot runs tests/buddy/overlay.test.html
the white-label tools (tools/whitelabel), which a build does not get
the store apps' workflow (.github/workflows/mobile.yml), which a build does not get
